questions.question_text: Which number corresponds to "Om Shri Sahajānandāya Namah" in the Sahajanand Namavali?
questions.explanation: The Sahajanand Namavali explicitly lists "Om Shri Sahajānandāya Namah" as the 40th name.

questions.question_text: Which of the following names is not found in the Sahajanand Namavali from 1 to 10?
questions.explanation: "Om Shri Anādaye Namah" is listed as the 11th name in the Sahajanand Namavali, not among the first 10.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks: "Je bhagwānnā bhaktane bhagwānno nishchay māhātmya sahit hoy ne santnu ne satsangīnu māhātmya ghaṇu _____, ne te bhaktnu jo karma kaṭhaṇ hoy ne kāḷ paṇ kaṭhaṇ hoy to paṇ te bhaktane evī bhaktinu atishay baḷ chhe, te kāḷ ne karma e bey maḷīne tenu bhūnḍu karī shaktā nathī."
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states "...santnu ne satsangīnu māhātmya ghaṇu jāṇto hoy...".

questions.question_text: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.72, what is true about a devotee who has a firm conviction in Bhagwān with mahatmya, and understands the greatness of the Sant and Satsangi?
options: Even if their karma and time are difficult, their devotion's strength will prevent harm.
They will always have easy karma and time.
They will not experience any difficulties.
Their devotion will only be strong if karma is not difficult.
questions.correct_answer: Even if their karma and time are difficult, their devotion's strength will prevent harm.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Pr.72 clearly states that "te kāḷ ne karma e bey maḷīne tenu bhūnḍu karī shaktā nathī" for such a devotee.

questions.question_text: According to Swa.Vato.5/250, what is stated about the "Moṭā"?
options: Moṭā lagār paṇ draṣhṭi kare to kāmādik pīḍī shake nahī.
Moṭā potānī meḷe game teṭalā dākhaḍā kare.
Kāmādik parābhav karyā vinā rahe ja nahī even with Moṭā's draṣhṭi.
questions.correct_answer: Moṭā lagār paṇ draṣhṭi kare to kāmādik pīḍī shake nahī.
questions.explanation: Swa.Vato.5/250 directly states, "Moṭā lagār paṇ draṣhṭi kare to kāmādik pīḍī shake nahī."

questions.question_text: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.47, why will one not attain satisfaction from sense pleasures even after becoming a devotee of Bhagwān and experiencing them for years?
options: Because sense pleasures are inherently short-lived.
Because the jiva has experienced these pleasures in countless bodies before and is still not satisfied.
Because Bhagwān prohibits sense pleasures entirely.
Because only one year of enjoyment is allowed.
questions.correct_answer: Because the jiva has experienced these pleasures in countless bodies before and is still not satisfied.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.47 explicitly mentions that the jiva has experienced these pleasures in countless bodies "to paṇ hajī lagaṇ e viṣhaynī tṛupti thaī nathī".

questions.question_text: Which analogy is used in Vach.Ga.Ma.47 to describe the unending nature of sense pleasure satisfaction?
options: Filling a small pot with ocean water.
Trying to fill a deep hole in the earth with water.
Trying to catch smoke in a net.
Drawing water from an empty well.
questions.correct_answer: Trying to fill a deep hole in the earth with water.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.47 uses the analogy: "Jem pātāḷ sudhī pṛuthvī fāṭī hoy tene pāṇīe karīne bharvā mānḍīe te kyārey bharāy nahī".

questions.question_text: According to Vach.Ga.An.38, which of the following is not one of the six things mentioned that prevents a person from attaining happiness in life or after death?
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.An.38 lists "kusangīmā het" and "sambandhīmā het" as detrimental, but "het in Sant" is not mentioned in this context.

questions.question_text: What should one do if they wish for happiness, according to Vach.Ga.An.38, if they possess the mentioned svabhāvs?
options: Accept them as part of their nature.
Seek spiritual guidance to manage them.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.An.38 concludes: "māṭe jene sukh ichchhavu hoy tene evā svabhāv hoy to ṭāḷvā."

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks: "Viṣhayno sambandh thayā morya to bakarānī peṭhe bīvu ne sambandh thaī jāy to tyā _____."
questions.explanation: Swa.Vato.2/993 states: "...ne sambandh thaī jāy to tyā sinh thāvu."

questions.question_text: Who is the author of the kirtan starting with "Hānjī bhalā sādhu, harikī sādh"?
questions.explanation: The kirtan "Hānjī bhalā sādhu..." is attributed to Muktanand Swami in the provided text.

questions.question_text: According to Muktanand Swami's kirtan, "Mān apamānme ekatā, sukhduḥkhme samabhāv; Ahī ke sukh alp hai, nahi svarga luchāv..." describes which characteristic of a sādhu?
questions.explanation: The first stanza of Muktanand Swami's kirtan describes "Tankī upādhi taje" through examples like "Mān apamānme ekatā, sukhduḥkhme samabhāv".

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks from Premanand Swami's kirtan: "Kām, krodh, lobh manmā na āṇe, Sonu ne dhūḷ te _____ karī jāṇe; Hā re jene gītājī gāy chhe pokārī re..."
questions.explanation: Premanand Swami's kirtan states: "Sonu ne dhūḷ te sam karī jāṇe".

questions.question_text: According to Bhaktichintamani.76/40, what will happen if one gives up their vrat and ṭek?
options: They will attain great happiness in the future.
They will be protected and cared for.
They will suffer the consequences of their own actions.
questions.correct_answer: They will suffer the consequences of their own actions.
questions.explanation: Bhaktichintamani.76/40 warns: "Paṇ vrat ṭek jo ṭāḷsho to, bhogavsho sahu sahu taṇu."

questions.question_text: According to Vach.Ga.An.2, what is stated about attaining parampad or moksh when santasamāgam is achieved?
options: One must leave the body to attain parampad.
Parampad is attained only after many lives.
Parampad or moksh is attained even while living in the body.
Santasamāgam is only helpful after death.
questions.correct_answer: Parampad or moksh is attained even while living in the body.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.An.2 confirms: "Māṭe jene parampad kahīe, moksh kahīe tene chhate dehe ja pāmyo chhe."

questions.question_text: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.3, what is the relationship between Brahma and Parabrahma Purushottam Narayan?
options: Brahma and Parabrahma are one and the same.
Parabrahma is separate from Brahma and is the cause, support, and inspirer of Brahma.
Brahma is the cause and support of Parabrahma.
questions.correct_answer: Parabrahma is separate from Brahma and is the cause, support, and inspirer of Brahma.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.3 explicitly states that Parabrahma Purushottam Narayan is "nokhā chhe ne e brahmanā paṇ kāraṇ chhe ne ādhār chhe ne prerak chhe".

questions.question_text: How should one worship Parabrahma according to Vach.Ga.Ma.3, after identifying their jivatma with Brahma?
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.3 instructs to worship Parabrahma in "svāmī-sevakbhāve upāsanā karvī".

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of Bhagwān's avatār, according to Vach.Ka.5?
options: To fulfill the desires of his beloved devotees.
questions.correct_answer: To fulfill the desires of his beloved devotees.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ka.5 clearly states: "Potānā je premī bhakta tenā manorath pūrā karvā e ja bhagwānne avatār dharyānu prayojan chhe."

questions.question_text: Who is the author of the kirtan that includes the line "Je je harie karyu het, evu kare koṇ āpaṇe re"?
questions.explanation: The kirtan "Je je harie karyu het..." is attributed to Nishkulanand Swami in the provided text.

questions.question_text: According to Nishkulanand Swami's kirtan, what happens if one does not understand Hari's compassion and protection?
options: Unmattāī (intoxication/pride) enters the body, and the mind turns to kusang.
questions.correct_answer: Unmattāī (intoxication/pride) enters the body, and the mind turns to kusang.
questions.explanation: Nishkulanand Swami's kirtan stanza 4 states: "Em samajyā vinā jan, āve unmattāī angmā re;... pachhī man māne kusangmā re..."
